Futile,Ⓒa.ⒹnirarTaka, moGa, vyarTa, nirguRa.
Ⓑ
 2 asAra, laGvarTa, niHsAra, niHsattva, Palgu, tfRaprAya, tucCa.
Ⓝ[Futil]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹmoGatA, lAGavaM, asAratA, &c.

Future,Ⓒa.ⒹBavizyat, uttara, anAgata, AgA-min, BAvin, uttarakAlIna, Svastana (nI f.); ‘f(uture) time’ anAgatavelA, uttarakAlaH, Ayati f.. []
Ⓑ
 2 pAralOkika-pAratrika-Amuzmika (kI f.), amutratya, paralokagata.
Ⓝ[Futur]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹBAvi-uttara-kAlaH, Bavizyat-AgAmi-kAlaH, BAvin n., anAgataM, anAgatakAlaH, Ayati f., udarkaH; ‘past, present and f(uture)’ samatItaM ca Bavacca BAvi ca (R. viii. 78); ‘ignorant of the f(uture)’ aSvastanavid, udarkAnaBijYa.
